summary: RoyaLand Co Ltd., a Bermuda holding company traded OTCQB under RLNDF, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on October 15, 2026, attaching a press release detailing its free-to-play mobile trading card game Viva Verdi, set during Italian reunification (1815-1871), targeting a Q4 2026 launch on iOS and Android. The release describes five factions, three modes, and in-game advertising monetization; no securities, ownership, price, or transaction terms were disclosed. This is a routine product-marketing disclosure, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
